recentItems.description:
Immerse Yourself In The Electrifying Title Song - Dont Trouble The Trouble! 

Lahari Music presents the official Malayalam Title Song from the magical entertainer Dont Trouble The Trouble (#DTTTMovie)

Presented by S. S. Rajamouli, starring the versatile Fahadh Faasil alongside Ssara Palekar and Saurabh Sachdeva. Composed and arranged by Kaala Bhairava, this high-energy track features powerful vocals by Kaala Bhairava and Baba Sehgal, with lyrics written by Aditya Iyengar.

Written and directed by Shashank Yeleti, and produced by Shobu Yarlagadda, Prasad Devineni, and S. S. Karthikeya under Arka Media Works and Showing Business.
